title: York University
description: York University's official brand standards define the primary colours York Red (#E31837), Black (#000000) and White (#FFFFFF), and the accent colours York Red Medium (#AF0D1A), York Red Dark (#810001), York Bright Blue (#3AC2EF), York Light Blue (#ACE6F8), York Light Grey (#E1DFDC), York Pewter (#D6CFCA), York Grey Medium (#B7AEA9) and York Grey Dark (#686260).
